rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound sa-antarāla indicating inclusion of an interval; analyzed as fused form
compound kapota-āli denoting a row of cornice elements
bahuvrīhi compound sapta-aṃśa specifying measure in seven parts
compound grāsa-paṭṭikā naming the architectural band element

items.question: What structural composition and proportional measure define the grāsapaṭṭikā architectural element?
premises: The cornice-row is measured as seven parts.
items.inference: Therefore, the grāsapaṭṭikā is defined as a cornice-row with an interspace measuring seven parts.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between sāntarālaṃ and kapotāliḥ is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The grāsapaṭṭikā is a cornice-row with an interspace, measuring seven parts.
